name: Four Seasons Hotel Hangzhou at Hangzhou Centre
positioning: City-centre Four Seasons hotel that anchors Hangzhou Centre, opened September 2024
best_for: Travelers who want a city-centre base with the metro steps away
Guests who want Hangzhou cityscape, West Lake or Grand Canal views from their room

facts.text: The hotel has 214 guest rooms and suites.
The hotel is at 493 Zhongshan North Road, Gongshu District, Hangzhou.
The hotel anchors Hangzhou Centre, a mixed-use hub of commerce and culture.
The Wulin Square station of the Hangzhou Metro is just steps away.
The Grand Canal is 0.1 kilometres from the hotel, a 5-minute walk.
Song is the hotel's one-Michelin-starred Chinese restaurant.
Charm is the all-day dining restaurant, on the 10th floor.
The spa is on the 18th floor and has 6 treatment rooms, including 2 couples' treatment rooms.
The hotel has a 25 x 8 metre indoor heated swimming pool.

highlights.text: Guest rooms offer views from the modern cityscape to West Lake and the Grand Canal.
The Panorama Room offers a 270-degree panoramic view.
Premier Suites have separate sleeping and living areas.
The Stellaris rooftop bar is on the 30th floor, overlooking the skyline of Hangzhou.
The gym has Technogym equipment and panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows.

considerations.text: Pets are not permitted in guest rooms or public areas.
The hotel is just a short drive from West Lake.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of luxury chain hotels.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
